description: The current published response description enumerates numeric project types 1 (DEFAULT), 2 (POWER_DIALER), 3 (SYNCED), 4 (AI_AGENT), 5 (DONT_CALL), and its enum contains those numbers, but the same required field declares type string. No JSON value satisfies both constraints. The node keeps the provider's project payload unchanged.
additional_defects: Full response generation also encounters object-typed fields with the string example any, and a string-typed lastCall.state with a numeric enum. The pinned contract and current official document contain these contradictions. The node does not reinterpret these fields or change the contract.
